invariants: No complaint must never be treated as proof of customer satisfaction
Customer success requires delivery evidence plus explicit satisfaction confirmation or equivalent evidence
Testimonial publication requires explicit customer permission
Referral request may only occur after customer success evidence exists
Referral contact details must not be harvested or contacted without appropriate customer/referral consent
A negative or unresolved satisfaction signal routes to follow-up, not testimonial or referral solicitation
Customer success evidence must be traceable to the relevant project and acceptance record
Testimonials must not be edited into materially different claims without customer approval
No incentive or reward may be promised unless separately approved and disclosed
